install_note: Needs the Rive CLI (a technical preview, free, no account for building or rendering): run python3 skills/rive/scripts/rive_doctor.py --install, which on macOS runs brew tap rive-app/tap and brew install --cask rive-app/tap/rive-cli (~30 MB; update with brew upgrade --cask rive-cli, not rive update) and on Linux x64 downloads the official build to ~/.rive/bin and checks its SHA-256. Scripts are stdlib Python 3.10+ plus ffmpeg. The optional web engine and page checks use Playwright with Chromium (shared with the browser skill) and fetch the pinned MIT web runtime (@rive-app/webgl2, ~2.7 MB) into a user cache. The Rive editor app (brew install --cask rive, ~210 MB) is optional and needs a Rive account signed in at the screen. On Linux with Mesa drivers captures come out blank until rive-app/rive-runtime#92 is fixed: see references/rendering.md.
